title: HookCreateRequest
description: Request body for creating a new webhook subscription.

type.description: The type of entity to watch for changes.

name.description: The name of the entity to watch. For packages, use the package name. For scopes, use the scope name (e.g., @myorg). For owners, use the npm username.

endpoint.description: The URI to receive webhook payloads via HTTP POST.

secret.description: A shared secret used to sign webhook payloads. The signature is included in the x-npm-signature header of each delivery.
